description: Paste a public repository — owner/repo, owner/repo@ref, a /sub/dir, or a full github.com URL. The repo must contain a conforming plugin.json and ship its built artifacts (no build runs on your machine).
desktopOnly: Installing from GitHub requires the Cognia desktop app.
fidelityContextual: Contextual: behaviour is rebuilt from what the source declared, not translated one-to-one.
fidelityNativeExact: Native Cognia plugin; no conversion required.
fidelityStructured: Structured: the manifest and its contributions carry over; anything host-specific is listed below.
fidelityUnsupported: Unsupported: this plugin cannot be converted without losing behaviour.
label: GitHub repository
title: Install from GitHub
